name_note: GTDB calls this species Scatacola_A faecigallinarum and its genomes carry the NCBI names Candidatus Scatocola faecigallinarum and Candidatus Scybalocola faecigallinarum; retrieved papers name the candidate genus Scatocola.

sentences.text: In a bullous pemphigoid-like mouse model comparing genetically identical C57BL/6J mice from two breeding facilities, a gut taxon belonging to Scatocola was identified as a candidate negative predictor of disease severity.
Another report described a machine learning model that identified a gut taxon most closely matching the candidate genus Scatocola as a strong negative predictor of disease severity.
In these retrieved reports the name appears as a candidate genus, Scatocola, detected as a gut taxon in mice.
